During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a '''research facility''' on the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]-owned [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Pallaxides]]. The facility was located in the lowlands near the equator, and also included a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Three [[Patrol ship/Legends|system patrol craft]] maintained a five hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] exclusion zone around the installation.<ref name="GTG" />
